schema_description: Синтетический интернет-магазин: категории, товары, клиенты, заказы, позиции заказов, платежи, отзывы. NULL допускается в categories.parent_id, customers.city, orders.channel, reviews.body.

profile_legend.aggregate: одна агрегатная функция или несколько по одной группировке
profile_legend.outer_join_aggregate: внешнее соединение с агрегатом (включая нулевые группы)
profile_legend.anti_join_null: анти-соединение через LEFT JOIN ... IS NULL
profile_legend.outer_join_predicate: внешнее соединение с предикатом в ON
profile_legend.semi_anti_join: комбинация EXISTS и NOT EXISTS в одном запросе
profile_legend.anti_join_subquery: анти-соединение через NOT EXISTS в подзапросе
profile_legend.top_n_ties: сортировка с LIMIT при возможных равенствах

breaking_profile_legend.multiplicity: состояние с повторяющимися строками и кратностями
breaking_profile_legend.nullable: состояние с NULL в необязательном столбце
breaking_profile_legend.zero_value: состояние с нулевой суммой или нулевым счётом

ddl: CREATE TABLE categories(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL UNIQUE, parent_id INTEGER NULL, FOREIGN KEY(parent_id) REFERENCES categories(id))

CREATE TABLE products(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sku VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL UNIQUE, name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, category_id INTEGER NOT NULL, price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, cost DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, stock INTEGER NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, created_at DATE NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(category_id) REFERENCES categories(id), CHECK(price >= 0), CHECK(cost >= 0), CHECK(stock >= 0))

CREATE TABLE customers(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, email VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL UNIQUE, name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, city VARCHAR(60) NULL, segment VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, created_at DATE NOT NULL, CHECK(segment IN ('retail','wholesale','vip')))

CREATE TABLE orders(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at DATE NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, channel VARCHAR(20) NULL, FOREIGN KEY(customer_id) REFERENCES customers(id), CHECK(status IN ('new','paid','shipped','cancelled','returned')))

CREATE TABLE order_items(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER NOT NULL, product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, unit_price DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, discount DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, FOREIGN KEY(order_id) REFERENCES orders(id), FOREIGN KEY(product_id) REFERENCES products(id), CHECK(quantity > 0), CHECK(unit_price >= 0), CHECK(discount >= 0), CHECK(discount <= unit_price))

CREATE TABLE payments(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER NOT NULL, paid_at DATE NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, method VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(order_id) REFERENCES orders(id), CHECK(amount >= 0), CHECK(method IN ('card','cash','transfer')))

CREATE TABLE reviews(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, rating INTEGER NOT NULL, body VARCHAR(200) NULL, created_at DATE NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(product_id) REFERENCES products(id), FOREIGN KEY(customer_id) REFERENCES customers(id), CHECK(rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5))
constraints: customers.segment NOT NULL, CHECK(segment IN (retail, wholesale, vip))
orders.status NOT NULL, CHECK(status IN (new, paid, shipped, cancelled, returned))
order_items.discount NOT NULL, CHECK(discount >= 0), CHECK(discount <= unit_price)
payments.method NOT NULL, CHECK(method IN (card, cash, transfer))
reviews.rating NOT NULL, CHECK(rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5)

families.reference_sql: SELECT c.id, COUNT(o.id) AS n FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.id

SELECT c.id, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price - oi.discount),0) AS total FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.id
SELECT cat.id, COUNT(p.id) AS n FROM categories cat LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id=cat.id GROUP BY cat.id ORDER BY cat.id

SELECT x.customer_id, x.total FROM (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) AS total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id GROUP BY o.customer_id) x WHERE x.total > 100 ORDER BY x.customer_id
